name: Eliashib
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return

points: Eliashib the priest, having oversight of the chambers of the house of God, was allied to Tobiah and had prepared him a great chamber where the offerings, tithes, and vessels had formerly been laid.

note.label: Nehemiah 13: Cleansing the People, the Sabbath, and the Strange Wives

source.name: TIPNR, Translators Individualised Proper Names with all References, by Tyndale House Cambridge, STEPBible.org

cases.charge: Preparing for Tobiah the Ammonite a great chamber in the court of the house of God, where the offerings, the frankincense, the vessels, and the tithes of the Levites had been laid; a grandson of the high priest son in law to Sanballat the Horonite
